evidence.title: Forjnot: Monorepo Starter for Scalable Projects

name: Forjnot
summary: Monorepo starter pairing a Next.js frontend with a NestJS backend in a Turborepo workspace.
description: A full-stack Turborepo starter with shared packages and configs: a Next.js frontend with static site generation and a modular NestJS backend, plus Swagger API docs, Biome linting, Docker/docker-compose deployment and a single lint/test/build gate used by CI.
contains: Next.js frontend + NestJS backend in one Turborepo
shared packages and configurations across apps
Biome, Makefile tasks and a one-command validation gate
two-branch template model with a branch strategy doc
